# Draft:Investigative Committee of the Republic of Armenia

----
Investigative Committee of the Republic of Armenia () is an investigative body, which was established on 19 May, 2014 based on the RA Law “On the Investigative Committee of the Republic of Armenia” adopted by the RA National Assembly..
The powers of the Investigative Committee include the organization and conduction of preliminary investigation in connection with alleged crimes within its jurisdiction, as provided by the Criminal Procedure Code of the Republic of Armenia․
The activity of the Investigative Committee is directed and supervised by the Chairman of the Investigative Committee.
The Chairman of the Investigative Committee is Artur Poghosyan.
The System of the Investigative Committee
The Investigative Committee includes Central Office, General Military Investigative Department, Investigative Department of Yerevan, Regional Investigative Departments.
The Subdivisions of Central Office of the Investigative Committee aregeneral departments, departments, divisions, supporting professional departments and divisions ․
* General Department for Investigation of Particularly Important Cases,
* General Department for Investigation of Economic Crimes and Smuggling,
* General Department for Investigation of Crimes against the State, Fundamentals of the Constitutional Order and Public Security,
* General Department for Control over Activity of Territorial Investigative Departments,
* General Department on Special Assignments,
* Department of Internal Security,
* Legal Department,
* Division of Provision of International Queries.
The Subdivisions of General Military Investigative Department are departments of General Military Investigative Department, garrison investigative units, supporting professional divisions ․
* Control Department,
* Department for Investigation of Particularly Important Cases,
* The Third Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Forth Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Fifth Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Sixth Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Seventh Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Eighth Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Ninth Garrison Investigative Unit,
* The Tenth Garrison Investigative Unit.
The Subdivisions of Investigative Department of Yerevan are divisions of the Investigative Department of Yerevan, supporting professional divisions and investigative divisions of administrative districts .
* Division for Investigation of Grave Crimes,
* Division for Investigation of Traffic Crimes,
* Division for Investigation of Crimes Committed at the Area of “Zvartnots” International Airport,
* Investigative Division of Ajapnyak and Davitashen administrative districts,
* Investigative Division of Avan and Nor Nork administrative districts,
* Investigative Division of Arabkir administrative district,
* Investigative Division of Erebuni and Nubarashen administrative districts,
* First Investigative Division of Kentron and Nork-Marash administrative districts,
* Second Investigative Division of Kentron and Nork-Marash administrative districts,
* Third Investigative Division of Kentron and Nork-Marash administrative districts,
* Investigative Division of Malatia-Sebastia administrative district,
* Investigative Division of Shengavit administrative district,
* Investigative Division of Qanaqer-Zeytun administrative district.
The Subdivisions of Regional Investigative Departments are territorial divisions of regional investigative department, supporting professional divisions
* Regional Investigative Department of Aragatsotn,
* Regional Investigative Department of Ararat,
* Regional Investigative Department of Armavir,
* Regional Investigative Department of Gegharkunik,
* Regional Investigative Department of Lori,
* Regional Investigative Department of Kotayk,
* Regional Investigative Department of Shirak,
* Regional Investigative Department of Syunik,
* Regional Investigative Department of Vayots Dzor,
* Regional Investigative Department of Tavush.

* Artur Poghosyan
